name: @tty-pt/chaff
description: Universal Node.js and Browser WebAssembly bindings for libchaff N-dimensional procedural noise and lattice stepping

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include native/chaff_napi.c -L/usr/lib -lxxhash -o build/Release/chaff_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: tty-pt
